tools.name: kb_list
tools.title: List Knowledge Bases
tools.description: Authoritatively list current knowledge bases. Call this in the current turn for knowledge-base names, IDs, or counts; do not infer them from search results or prior context. `documents` is the indexed document/file count and `chunks` is the indexed chunk count (not file count).

chunks.description: Current indexed chunk count; not a file count.

tools.name: kb_get_capabilities
tools.title: Get Service Capabilities
tools.description: Read service capabilities plus the native MCP contract summary without secrets.

tools.name: kb_create
tools.title: Create Knowledge Base
tools.description: Create a new knowledge base.

tools.name: kb_get
tools.title: Get Knowledge Base
tools.description: Authoritatively read one knowledge base's current metadata, counts, and retrieval config summary. Do not use it to enumerate filenames: call kb_list_documents for that. `jobCount` counts ingest attempts, including repeated processing of one document, so it is not a file count.

kbId.description: Optional KB id; defaults to the configured default KB

chunks.description: Current indexed chunk count; not a file count.

jobCount.description: Ingest attempt count; repeated processing can create multiple jobs for one document, so this is not a file count.

tools.name: kb_search
tools.title: Search Knowledge Base
tools.description: Search a knowledge base for chunks relevant to a semantic question and ground the answer in the returned passages. Search results are not a complete inventory: never use them to claim exact filenames or file counts; call kb_list_documents for inventory questions.

kbId.description: Optional KB id; defaults to the configured default KB

query.description: The user question, in their original language

topK.description: Optional number of chunks to retrieve, 1-20

tools.name: kb_upload
tools.title: Upload Document
tools.description: Upload and index exactly one source into a specific knowledge base: either contentBase64 bytes or an absolute host path when pathUpload is advertised. Use this write path for drive-resolved local files.

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded document bytes for remote clients. Exactly one of contentBase64 or path is required.

externalAssetId.description: Optional opaque source association shared with related representations; use letters, digits, dots, underscores, colons and hyphens, not URLs, paths or credentials

filename.description: Filename for contentBase64 uploads; required when contentBase64 is used

kbId.description: Target KB id; required for writes

mime.description: Optional MIME type for contentBase64 uploads

path.description: Absolute host path under an allowed upload root; only available when pathUpload is advertised. Exactly one of path or contentBase64 is required.

tools.name: kb_prepare_upload
tools.title: Prepare Direct Upload
tools.description: Prepare a short-lived direct binary upload. The MCP client must read the local file and PUT its raw bytes to the returned upload URL. Audio requires the advertised upload.audio capability and remains asynchronous; kb_upload contentBase64 is a compatibility fallback for supported documents, not audio.

externalAssetId.description: Optional opaque source association shared with related representations; never supply a signed URL, local path or credential

filename.description: Supported filename for the local file; the server never reads this path

idempotencyKey.description: Optional key for safe preparation retries

kbId.description: Target KB id; required for writes

sha256.description: Optional lowercase SHA-256 digest of the local file

sizeBytes.description: Exact local file size in bytes

tools.name: kb_list_documents
tools.title: List Documents
tools.description: Authoritatively list current indexed documents in one knowledge base. For 'which files are in the KB?', exact filenames, or exact file counts, MUST call this tool in the current turn, follow nextCursor until complete, and answer only from the returned documents. Never add names inferred from search results, document contents, memory, or job counts.

cursor.description: Optional opaque cursor from the previous result

kbId.description: Optional KB id; defaults to the configured default KB

limit.description: Optional page size, max 100; omit with cursor for the default page size

tools.name: kb_get_document
tools.title: Get Document
tools.description: Authoritatively read one current document's metadata and derived counts, including queued documents. Audio documents include retained-original, transcription and indexing status separately. Call this for exact document identity or status instead of inferring it from search passages. `jobCount` counts processing attempts for this document, not documents.

kbId.description: Optional KB id; defaults to the configured default KB

durationMs.description: Measured duration in milliseconds, or zero until audio validation completes.

jobCount.description: Processing attempt count for this document; not a document count.

tools.name: kb_list_document_chunks
tools.title: List Document Chunks
tools.description: Authoritatively list indexed chunks for one document; chunk text is capped. Use it for chunk/page inspection, not to infer the knowledge base's file inventory.

kbId.description: Optional KB id; defaults to the configured default KB

tools.name: kb_read_document_text
tools.title: Read Extracted Document Text
tools.description: Authoritatively read extracted/indexed text for one document, including PDF and OCR output. Call this when the user asks what a specific document says instead of reconstructing it from search snippets. Use this for parsed documents instead of the raw file reader. Output is capped.

kbId.description: Optional KB id; defaults to the configured default KB

tools.name: kb_read_document_raw
tools.title: Read Original Text File
tools.description: Read the original stored UTF-8 text file only; binary files are rejected. Use kb_read_document_text for extracted PDF, Office, image, or OCR content. Output is capped.

kbId.description: Optional KB id; defaults to the configured default KB

tools.name: kb_list_document_faq
tools.title: List Document FAQs
tools.description: List generated FAQ suggestions for a document.

kbId.description: Optional KB id; defaults to the configured default KB

tools.name: kb_reindex_document
tools.title: Reindex Document
tools.description: Rebuild a document from stored raw content, or use strategy auto to reuse existing chunks when only embeddings are stale. Explicit document confirmation is required.

durationMs.description: Measured duration in milliseconds, or zero until audio validation completes.

jobCount.description: Processing attempt count for this document; not a document count.

tools.name: kb_import_url
tools.title: Import URL
tools.description: Fetch a readable remote URL into a specific KB; this usually enqueues ingest work, so follow progress with kb_get_job or kb_list_jobs.

async.description: Whether to enqueue async ingest; defaults to true

idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key for safe retries

kbId.description: Target KB id; required for writes

tools.name: kb_list_jobs
tools.title: List Ingest Jobs
tools.description: Authoritatively list recent ingest jobs for a KB, including queued/running/succeeded/failed/cancelled progression. Jobs are processing attempts and multiple jobs may reference one document; never treat job totals or filenames as a document inventory.

kbId.description: Optional KB id; defaults to the configured default KB

tools.name: kb_get_job
tools.title: Get Ingest Job
tools.description: Read one ingest job's current queued/running/succeeded/failed/cancelled status and provenance.

kbId.description: Optional KB id; defaults to the configured default KB

tools.name: kb_retry_job
tools.title: Retry Ingest Job
tools.description: Retry one failed or cancelled ingest job after inspecting its prior status.

tools.name: kb_cancel_job
tools.title: Cancel Ingest Job
tools.description: Cancel one queued or running ingest job; destructive to in-flight ingest and requires explicit job confirmation.

confirmJobId.description: Must exactly equal jobId as an explicit destructive-action confirmation

tools.name: kb_read_handbook
tools.title: Read Handbook
tools.description: Read the JishuDB handbook or one exact heading section.

section.description: Optional exact handbook heading to extract

tools.name: kb_get_config
tools.title: Get Sanitized Configuration
tools.description: Read a sanitized allowlisted summary of runtime retrieval/model settings.

extensions.description: Legacy upload compatibility set; some accepted formats may still return cannot_parse.

indexableExtensions.description: Strict parser-backed subset for managed ingestion clients.

tools.name: kb_delete_document
tools.title: Delete Document
tools.description: Delete a document from a knowledge base; destructive and requires explicit document confirmation.

confirmDocumentId.description: Must exactly equal documentId as an explicit destructive-action confirmation

tools.name: kb_delete_kb
tools.title: Delete Knowledge Base
tools.description: Delete an entire knowledge base and all indexed content; destructive and requires explicit KB confirmation.

confirmKbId.description: Must exactly equal kbId as an explicit destructive-action confirmation

tools.name: kb_get_readiness
tools.title: Check Runtime Readiness
tools.description: Check the target knowledge base's basic text ingestion and retrieval runtime. Model presence is distinct from verified inference; OCR and optional dependencies are reported separately.

tools.name: kb_prepare_runtime
tools.title: Prepare Authorized Runtime
tools.description: Continue or retry the built-in embedding preparation explicitly approved during local Agent onboarding. Requires separate preparation authority; cannot change settings, URLs, paths or models.

tools.name: note_list
tools.title: List Notes
tools.description: List source-note metadata and linked knowledge-base state. Note content, attachments, and local paths are not returned.

tools.name: note_get
tools.title: Get Note
tools.description: Read one source note and its linked knowledge-base state. Local paths and attachments are not returned.

tools.name: note_create
tools.title: Create Note
tools.description: Create a source-only Markdown note. It is not searchable until note_link_to_kb explicitly links the saved revision. Supply noteId and createdAt for retry-safe creation; omitted values are generated for a one-off create.

tools.name: note_update
tools.title: Update Note
tools.description: Replace a source note after explicit version confirmation. Linked knowledge-base documents refresh automatically after 30 seconds of source inactivity; no relink is required.

tools.name: note_delete
tools.title: Delete Note
tools.description: Delete a source note after explicit version and note-ID confirmation. Linked knowledge-base documents and their derived indexes are deleted; an already queued or processing refresh is cancelled.

tools.name: note_link_to_kb
tools.title: Link Note to Knowledge Base
tools.description: Link the current saved source revision to one knowledge base and queue its first searchable snapshot. Repeating an existing link safely returns its current membership and job state, even with a stale expectedUpdatedAt.

tools.name: kb_update
tools.title: Update Knowledge Base
tools.description: Update a knowledge base name and/or description. At least one mutable field is required.

tools.name: kb_update_document
tools.title: Update Document Title
tools.description: Update only an indexed document title. Source provenance and ingest audit metadata are immutable through this tool.

durationMs.description: Measured duration in milliseconds, or zero until audio validation completes.

jobCount.description: Processing attempt count for this document; not a document count.

tools.name: kb_get_job_trace
tools.title: Get Ingest Job Trace
tools.description: Read sanitized ingest-job stage timing. Span metadata and source provenance are never returned.

tools.name: kb_list_sources
tools.title: List Knowledge Sources
tools.description: List configured Feishu and local-folder sources for a knowledge base. Credentials, URLs, and local paths are not returned.

tools.name: kb_sync_source
tools.title: Sync Knowledge Source
tools.description: Request one manual Feishu sync or local-folder rescan for an existing source. This tool cannot register, configure, disconnect, or remove sources.
